Methodology

Each week, YouGov invites around 1,500 members of its opt-in panel to complete an online questionnaire. The respondents are selected to be representative of American adult citizens and the data is weighted to represent the country according to gender, age, race, education and voting behaviour. To track the results of YouGov’s polling over time, The Economist aggregates survey data each week and fits a line of best fit. All three went for Trump in the 2016, 2020, and 2020 presidential elections, USA TODAY reported.
